assignment.serviceTierQualifier: Fast requested; no distinct exposed service-tier control was available.

accessModel.enforcement: Instruction-only limits in a shared executor; no OS isolation or access audit.
accessModel.curator: Source-exposed curator supplied the body-free contract.

retainedExpression: Exact existing protocol/schema/fields/prose/constants/format/evaluation material; no new grant/novelty claim

chosenStructure.description: Private result types followed by three public functions, each expressing its own ordered admission gates and terminal outcomes directly. Persistence has reuse, inline, and durable outcomes; content recovery keeps its storage operation inside one narrow try/catch; original-reference selection remains a synchronous path/content decision.
chosenStructure.rationale: Keeping guards and field observations at their use sites preserves lazy branches, repeated live reads, receiver binding, and exception boundaries without an extra cache or helper changing observation timing.

preservedContract.publicApi: All three exported function names, parameter shapes, return types, and both private result types retained.
imports: SessionId, ToolArtifactStorePort, TraceContext, TurnAttachment, TurnId imported as types from ../deps.js
persist: Truthy existingArtifactUri is observed first; metadata URI and URL are separate subsequent reads.
Missing artifactStore or sessionId is checked left-to-right; inline metadata has no artifactUri own key.
Durable write uses artifactStore as method receiver; request fields retain content, contentType, retention, sessionId, toolCallId, toolName, trace, turnId order and options signal.
No write catch: durable rejection propagates unchanged; result URI reads remain separate.
No URI admission, decoding, index validation, inferred grants, alternate durable owner, or cache.
read: Falsy content, case-sensitive data: prefix, then isArtifactUri admission and missing store gates preserve order and repeated content reads.
Initial getters and URI classification stay outside try; read call and artifact content observations stay inside try.
Read request preserves trace then uri field order, receiver binding, and absence of a second options argument.
Stored data: content returns exact attachment reference and live artifact content; read and in-try content failures return undefined.
originalRef: Truthy path returns a fresh path read immediately; falsy content yields undefined.
Data URL references map to inline:data-url; all other admitted content reference strings remain unchanged.
No expanded scheme decision or blanket redaction claim.

verification.method: Manual source inspection against the six body-free frozen inputs; byte, SHA256 and line accounting only.

outputs.sha256: Reported separately after freeze; a receipt cannot contain its own SHA256 digest.

cooperativeFreeze.timing: Files and directory frozen immediately after this record was finalized; curator review occurs afterward.
